thesis: Dark Ritual converts a card into a temporary two-mana profit, allowing black decks to exchange long-term resources for an opening that the opponent may never recover from.

competitiveTimeline.significance: Historical decks show Ritual moving from Hypnotic Specter and Necropotence to storm combo, reanimation, and eternal black aggression.

playbook.role: Ritual is best when it produces immediate disruption, a resilient threat, or a combo line. Avoid accelerating a fragile permanent into open removal unless the tempo or information gained justifies the card disadvantage.

counterplay.directAnswers: Cheap removal and free countermagic punish all-in starts; graveyard hate and discard attack the combo shells that use Ritual as velocity. Surviving the opening burst often leaves the Ritual deck with fewer cards and weaker topdecks.
